tasks.description: brief-generator.ts — Claude generates hook, caption, hashtags per IA item
tasks.context:
Create /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/tools/tiktok-briefs/src/brief-generator.ts

Uses the Anthropic API (claude-3-5-haiku-20241022 — fast + cheap) to generate structured TikTok briefs from IA item metadata + topic config.

Imports:
```typescript
import Anthropic from '@anthropic-ai/sdk';
import type { StoredItem } from '../../ia-scraper/src/storage.js';
import type { TopicConfig } from '../../ia-scraper/src/viral-topics.js';
import { VIRAL_TOPICS } from '../../ia-scraper/src/viral-topics.js';
import type { TikTokBrief } from './briefs-storage.js';
```

Exports:
```typescript
export async function generateBrief(
  item: StoredItem,
  sprintId: string
): Promise<TikTokBrief>;
```

Implementation:
1. Find the topic config: `const topic = VIRAL_TOPICS.find(t => t.id === item.topic_id)`
2. Build a prompt for Claude:
```
You are a TikTok content strategist. Generate a viral content brief for this archival video.

SOURCE:
Title: {item.title}
Description: {item.description ?? 'N/A'}
URL: {item.source_url}
Topic: {topic.name}
Viral triggers: {topic.triggers.join(', ')}
Caption strategy from research: {topic.caption_strategy}
Music genre: {topic.music_genre}
Score: {item.score}/100

Generate a JSON object with exactly these fields:
{
  "hook": "<3-7 word on-screen text for first 3 seconds — punchy, creates immediate curiosity>",
  "caption": "<full TikTok caption, 100-200 chars, with line breaks, engaging, matches hook energy>",
  "hashtags": ["<5-8 hashtags WITHOUT the # symbol, mix of niche and broad>"],
  "music_direction": "<1-2 sentences: specific genre, tempo, mood, and a royalty-free style reference>",
  "duration_seconds": <integer 15-34 for TikTok>,
  "viral_trigger": "<single word: the primary trigger from: awe|shock|amusement|inspiration|nostalgia|curiosity|satisfaction|debate>"
}

Return ONLY valid JSON. No explanation.
```
3. Parse the JSON response
4. Build and return TikTokBrief object:
```typescript
{
  ia_identifier: item.identifier,
  topic_id: item.topic_id ?? '',
  topic_name: topic?.name ?? '',
  source_url: item.source_url,
  source_title: item.title,
  hook: parsed.hook,
  caption: parsed.caption,
  hashtags: parsed.hashtags,
  music_direction: parsed.music_direction,
  duration_seconds: parsed.duration_seconds,
  platform: topic?.platform_priority[0] ?? 'tiktok',
  viral_trigger: parsed.viral_trigger,
  score: item.score,
  status: 'draft',
  sprint_id: sprintId,
}
```

Error handling: if Claude returns invalid JSON, retry once. If still invalid, throw with item identifier in message.

Use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from process.env. Max 100 lines.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: generateBrief() for a real StoredItem returns a TikTokBrief with hook <= 50 chars, hashtags.length >= 5, duration_seconds in [15,34]
